## How you tested it

- [ ] `npm run test:unit` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` done and the new `index.html` committed (`npm run check-build`)
- [ ] `npm run smoke` passes
- [ ] Tried in: Chrome / Safari / Firefox / the macOS screen saver

## Before merging

- [ ] No secrets or personal data in the diff
- [ ] README and NOTICE match the change
- [ ] New dependencies are licensed and credited
